improvements.title: Make the recipe menu keyboard operable
improvements.current_behavior: Menu button cannot be reached with Tab.
improvements.desired_behavior: Complete the menu-to-recipe journey with keyboard alone; focus returns to the trigger on close.
improvements.why_it_matters: Reduces avoidable barriers to finding and saving a meal.
improvements.proposed_change: Use a semantic button and support focus, Enter, Space, and Escape.
improvements.expected_benefit: Hypothesis: more users complete the affected task.

effort.assumptions: Estimate assumes reusable components and existing test coverage.

acceptance_criteria: Complete the menu-to-recipe journey with keyboard alone; focus returns to the trigger on close.

success_metric.name: Affected journey completion
success_metric.measurement_method: Repeat the specified journey before and after the change in the same environment.
success_metric.guardrail: Do not regress keyboard access, responsiveness, or data minimization.

improvements.priority_rationale: Ranked by severity, with equal-severity ties by estimated effort.
